title: Governed Pick, Pack, Pickup, Acceptance and Exception Workflow
scope: pick, pack and ready transitions resolve a canonical inventory allocation and require bounded fulfillment authority
warehouse operator identity must match the actor executing fulfillment work and handover
pickup handover is evidence-backed and remains distinct from member acceptance and obligation discharge
member acceptance is an independently authorized member act resolved against the canonical purchase commitment participant
partial acceptance discharges only actually accepted quantity
shortfall/rejection exception capture requires acceptance linkage and cannot exceed unresolved quantity
exception capture does not automatically create or complete a remedy

invariants.INV-001: PARTIAL_GREEN strengthened: fulfillment work, handover, acceptance and exception capture require AuthorityEvaluator approval rather than UI role.
invariants.INV-004: PARTIAL_GREEN strengthened: fulfillment effects are bound to canonical allocation and purchase-commitment relationships.
invariants.INV-019: PARTIAL_GREEN strengthened: handover remains distinct from acceptance and discharge at the SW1 operator/member boundary.
invariants.INV-020: PARTIAL_GREEN strengthened: only accepted quantity is recorded as performed; shortfall remains unresolved.
invariants.INV-030: No promotion. SW1 composition reuses SW0 fulfillment/remedy semantics and does not invent automatic remedy or transfer meaning.

negativePaths: handover without separate acceptance leaves obligation open
future-dated fulfillment evidence rejected by application boundary
next: SW1-07 refund/replacement remedies and obligation resolution
